summary.plain: A 12-metre sphere holding 818 tonnes of clear mineral oil, watched by 1,520 light sensors, 541 metres from where Fermilab makes its Booster neutrino beam. Flashes of light reveal the particles a neutrino leaves behind.
summary.technical: Spherical 12.2 m diameter mineral-oil Cherenkov/scintillation detector with 1520 usable 8-inch photomultipliers, 818 t of mineral oil, centred 541 m from the upstream face of the Booster Neutrino Beam target.
